main_text.p: Piscari : Hiph. Præter. וְדִינוּם Et pistabuntur eos, Jer.16.16. pro וְהֽדִינוּם. Simile vide in רוּב.

הָג m. Piscis, Jon.2.1. Semel cum epenthesi, דָּאג Neh.13. v.16. Plur. דָּגִים Job.40.26. Constr. דְּגֵי הַיָּם Pisces maris, Gen.9.2. Fœm. דָּגָה, Deut.4.18. Constr. דְּגַת יְאֹרִיךָ Piscem rivorum tuorum, Ezech.29.4. Aff. דְּגָתָם כִּדְגַת הַיָּם Pisces eorum, sicut pisces maris, Ezech.47.10. Hæc duo sunt à Verbo דָּגָה propter mutationem Kametz in Schera, sicut שָׁנָה à שֶׁנַת.
דַּיָּג m. Piscator: Plur. הַדַּיָּגִים Piscatores, Jef.19.8. לְדַוָּגִים Ad piscatores, Jerem.16.16. quod scribitur cum ו, sed legendum per י : לְדַיָּגִים.
דָּוָג m. Idem: Plural. דָּוָגִים Piscatores, Ezech.47.10.

דּוֹד m. Dilectus, Amicus: synecdochicè Patruus, 1.Sam.10.15. Aff. דּוֹדִי Dilectus meus, Cant.6.1.2. אֶל־דּוֹדוֹ Ad patruum suum, 1.Sam.10.16. דּוֹדְךָ Dilectus tuus, Cant.5.17. Plural. דּוֹדִים Dilecti, Cant.5.1. Et substantivè, Amores: עֵת דּוֹדִים Tempus amorū, Ezech.16.8. Aff. דּוֹדֶיךָ Amores tui, Cantic.1.2.4. & 4.10. Hinc דָּוִיד David, Zach.12.8.10.12. & 13.1. vel דָּוִד q. Dilectus.
דֹּדָה f. Amita: Aff. דֹּדָתוֹ Amitam suam, Exod.6.20.

דּוּד m. Calathus, Canistrum, Sporta, Jerem.24.2. Lebes, 1.Sam.2.14. Pelvis, Labellum, quo fertur argilla aut intrita cōsiciendorum laterum, Psal.81.7. secundum Ab.Esram: Ahenum, Job.41.11. Plural. כְּדוּדִים In sportas, 2.Reg.10.7. Et cum ו mobili, וּכְדוּרִים Et in lebetibus, 2.Par.35.13. Constr. cum Epenthesi, דּוּדֵי Sporta, Calathi, Jer.24.1. Similem Epenthesin vide in לוּל.
דּוּדָאִים m.p. Mandragoræ, juxta communem interpretum sententiam, Gen.30.14. Quidam, Flores amabiles, quasi à superiore דּוֹד deductum. Oder illis ascribitur Cant.7.13.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are copied from the scan but the pointing is faint and several vowel points are doubtful; the running head "דו" at top left is uncertain. The large letter at the left of the first entry is partly illegible; the Hebrew in the entry "Piscari" and in "Constr. cum Epenthesi" is uncertain. The whole entry at line 4 ("Plur. דָּגִים") and the root forms throughout should be checked against the original.
